pending_commit.commit_message: tast: Build and push files at one place. Previously, local test bundles, remote test bundles and local test runner were built and pushed separately, which was wasting some time. This change moves all logic about building and pushing files to the beginning of run.Run and utilizes parallel Go build for speed up. autotest: network_TwoShills: Stop assuming default routes are in main table Prior to CL:1590183, all default routes were placed in the main routing table. Now that per-device routing tables are used, default routes for a particular device are placed in the device's corresponding routing table. Since `ip route show` only shows routes in the main routing table, it is expected that `ip route show default match 0/0` will not return anything. Appending ' table 0' to the command causes routes from all routing tables to be dumped, rather than just the main routing table. Note that this change will not break network_TwoShills on devices running images before 77, as in that case adding ' table 0' will not do anything. BUG=chromium:982504, chromium:941597 TEST=`test_that $BOARD $HOST network_TwoShills` failed before this change but now passes. Change-Id: Ic52d33b53ec4326b647787c022c8956178b9c61b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1696227 Tested-by: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org>
